about.en: DODO is the governance and utility token of DODO, a decentralized exchange and liquidity protocol built around its Proactive Market Maker (PMM) algorithm, which uses price oracles to concentrate liquidity near the market price. DODO was issued on Ethereum at 0x43Dfc4159D86F3A37A5A4B3D4580b888ad7d4DDd, with DODO-deployed versions on BNB Smart Chain, Arbitrum and other networks.
